description: This file defines the GeminiHandler class, a provider for interacting with Google's Gemini models, including model loading, message creation, prompt completion, and cost calculation.

classes.name: GeminiHandler
classes.description: A class that manages interactions with Google's Gemini models, including message streaming, model loading, and cost calculation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the GeminiHandler with options, sets up the GoogleGenAI client based on credentials and configuration.

methods.name: ensureModelsLoaded
methods.description: Ensures Gemini models are loaded, avoiding redundant fetches.

methods.name: loadModels
methods.description: Fetches available Gemini models from the API.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a message stream with the Gemini API, handling thoughts, tool calls, grounding, and cost tracking.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the current model info, dynamically loaded, with parameters.

methods.name: extractCitationsOnly
methods.description: Generates citation links from grounding metadata.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt with the Gemini API, appending sources if available.

methods.name: calculateCost
methods.description: Calculates the cost of API usage based on tokens and model pricing tiers.
